business_summary: The advertiser sells consumer electronics accessories, specifically fast chargers, power banks, and cables, targeting laptop and phone users with a typical purchase size of $20-60.
product: Fast chargers, power banks, and cables
stated_claims: We want phone-and-laptop users, and I'd say everyone qualifies.

relevant_tags.why: Charging accessories are highly practical, utility-driven purchases with strong impulse appeal.
The advertiser operates as a direct-to-consumer brand selling accessories.
Power banks and fast chargers are popular, universal practical gifts.
Laptop and phone users in professional environments have a high daily utility for charging accessories.

note_signals.why: High-frequency, impulse-friendly convenience shoppers are prime targets for quick $20-60 accessory purchases.
Tech-adjacent urban professionals heavily rely on phones and laptops, representing the ideal core audience.
Strong gifting season uplift matches well with universal, practical electronic stocking stuffers.

gate_reason: The product category, broad consumer audience, and price point are clearly defined and highly suitable for post-purchase DTC audiences.
